name: Interactive Semi-supervised Segmentation (Dual-Domain)
definition: A semi-supervised segmentation approach where users guide the process interactively, working simultaneously in the histogram-coupled transfer function domain and the volume rendering domain.
summary: Interactive Semi-supervised Segmentation (Dual-Domain) isolates volumetric features by coupling user interactions in the histogram transfer function and rendering domains, maintaining real-time visual feedback while propagating intent via Kindlemann’s algorithm.
